note: Japanese night. 事 si6 first, then the Hard な/は/ま cards, then the ま/み/れ/ろ recap, then 20 new: やゆよわをん + がぎぐげご + 9 words. 写三遍，念出声。

tasks.prompt: Warm-up: say 事 (si6, low flat tone 低平调) three times in a row. Low and flat, not rising like 試 si3.
tasks.script: 事 si6 · 事 si6 · 事 si6 (low, flat, no rise)

tasks.title: NHK hiragana chart · tap や–よ, わ, を, ん and the が行 dakuten rows
Read without romaji first (only kana you know)

lines.text: やま は たかい
lines.translation: the mountain is high · 山很高 (は = wa; たかい is new, just listen)
a snowy night · 下雪的夜晚

lines.text: わたし は げんき
ごはん を たべる

lines.translation: a book and a key · 书和钥匙

tasks.prompt: Write やゆよわをん and がぎぐげご ×3 each, saying each aloud (~5 min). Then read the 5 lines twice, slow then normal speed. Watch: ね vs ぬ vs な (Hard earlier), は vs ほ, ま vs み. が = か with two dots, sounds 'ga'.
tasks.script:
ya yu yo wa wo n · ga gi gu ge go
やま は たかい (yama wa takai)
ゆき の よる (yuki no yoru)
わたし は げんき (watashi wa genki)
ごはん を たべる (gohan o taberu)
ほん と かぎ (hon to kagi)

questions.explain: わ wa; ね and れ look similar but have a loop/kick at the end.
が = か plus two dots (dakuten).
ぬ nu curls at the end; め me does not.

questions.q: In ごはん を たべる, how is を read?
questions.explain: を sounds like 'o'; it marks the object.

questions.q: Which is ha / ho: は vs ほ — which is ho?
questions.explain: ほ has an extra bar on top; は is plain.
